findings.title: Endorsement cluster shares too many identity or affiliation signals
findings.evidence: 5 endorsement edges share device, recovery, invite, or affiliation signals.

findings.evidence: rep-1 overlap ratio=0.67 from 3 reviewer slots.
findings.action: Require independent reviewers before applying the reputation or badge delta.
